identity.title: Identity, art direction & UX/UI
identity.problem: An activity that is hard to distinguish, or interfaces that are difficult to navigate.
identity.benefit: Clarify your identity, organise user journeys and create a consistent visual language, from an existing logo to everyday screens.

web.problem: A website that no longer presents your offering or supports your users properly.
web.benefit: Build a tailored website or platform with a clear structure, relevant content and routes towards the actions that matter.

business.title: Business applications & software
business.problem: Scattered information and operations managed across several files.
business.benefit: Bring data and actions together in an appropriate tool: a business application, platform or back office, with the necessary access controls and functions.

automation.title: Automation & API integrations
automation.problem: Repeated data entry and tools that do not exchange information effectively.

ai.title: Applied artificial intelligence
ai.problem: Content or information to process, without knowing where AI would help.
ai.benefit: Assess a specific use case such as assistance, search or information processing. Test its relevance, limits and data requirements before integration.

seo.problem: A website that is hard to find, or a journey that makes enquiries difficult.

sections.title: Personal data
sections.content: Information sent through the contact form (name, email and, where provided, phone, organisation, subject and message) is used only to review and answer your enquiry. It passes through the website server, hosted by Vercel, and is then forwarded to Nova Baie by the Make automation tool. To limit abuse, an encrypted, non-reversible fingerprint of the email address is kept for 15 minutes at most. This data is never sold or used for advertising. You can request access, correction or deletion of your data at contact.novabaie@gmail.com, and lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content: The website uses no advertising cookies. Without your consent, no measurement tool is loaded: only your choice is remembered in your browser, for 6 months. If you accept audience measurement, Google Tag Manager loads Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd), which sets cookies (_ga, _ga_*) for up to 13 months to produce traffic statistics; advertising signals remain denied. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time with the “Manage cookies” link at the bottom of every page.

faq.title: Before you get in touch.
items: What kind of projects do you deliver?
Premium websites, web platforms, back offices and business applications, automation and API integrations, along with the identity and search work that supports them.
Do you only work in the Bay of Somme?
No. Nova Baie is based in the Bay of Somme and supports projects across France: discussions, approvals and follow-up can all take place remotely.
Which sectors do you work with?

Tourism and accommodation, concierge services and real estate, associations and sports clubs, craftspeople, shops, small and medium businesses, brands and private projects. How your organisation works is always the starting point.
Can you take over an existing website or tool?
Yes. We first review what exists, what can be kept and what needs to change, before proposing a scope.
Yes: page structure, metadata, structured data, performance and content are considered from the design stage, then followed up according to your priorities.
Ongoing support can be agreed: fixes, updates and new features, on terms defined for each project.
Tell us about your organisation and your needs through the form, by email or by phone. A first conversation helps clarify the need before any personalised proposal.

consent.title: Your choice, simply.
consent.text: With your consent, we measure website traffic with Google Analytics to improve it. No advertising cookies. Without consent, no measurement tool is loaded.
consent.essentialText: Remembering your choice and running the website.
consent.analyticsText: Visit statistics, with no advertising use. Cookies kept for 13 months at most.
